prompt: For the dispatch dashboard I need a new endpoint that lists every vehicle together with its currently active trip, if it has one. Each row should be the vehicle plus its active trip's trip_id, trip_status, the driver's full name, and origin/destination. I want it as GET /api/vehicles/dispatch-board, and I also need a getDispatchBoard() function added to src/services/vehicle.service.js so the dashboard component can call it.
assertions: Route file created at src/app/api/vehicles/dispatch-board/route.js exporting a GET handler
Handler calls requireAuth, wraps logic in try/catch ending with handleError, returns ok(...)
SQL runs through query() from @/lib/db with $n placeholders; no user input interpolated into SQL strings
Returns one row per vehicle with an active_trip object (trip_id, trip_status, origin, destination) or null when no active trip
Active trip filtered by in-flight statuses consistent with the repo's trips/active convention and excludes soft-deleted trips (deleted_at IS NULL)
Driver full name included in the active trip payload (joined through drivers -> employees)
getDispatchBoard() added to src/services/vehicle.service.js using apiFetch

SQL references columns that exist in the LATEST migration state: origin/destination resolved via trips.origin_location_id/destination_location_id -> locations (migration 007 drops trips.origin/destination), not the dropped columns
